title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Night Fascia. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Night Fascia
options.lineage: Pakistani computer-shop LED fascia after dark
options.thesis: The books are the shopfront at night: four backlit acrylic modules answer profit, cash, spend, and stock.
options.viewport: A dark shutter wall. Four lit fascia modules across the top. A cyan sales ticker under them. Inventory as bin plates. Record sale and expense sit as till keys on the right.
options.risk: Falls into generic neon dashboard if the LEDs bloom instead of reading as cheap commercial channel letters.

raised.raise: Figures sit on an LED module pitch. Flash is reserved for alerts only.
Body data shares one size. Only the four glance figures step up.
Panels meet at a hard acrylic seam. No card chrome.
Zones are named in channel letters: PROFIT, CASH, SPEND, STOCK. A live item keeps a packing tag.
Profit is sales pulling against expenses. Both members stay visible.

options.label: Dealer Rate List
options.thesis: Today's books are a dealer sheet: four highlighter cells, ballpoint stock, red stamp for loss.
options.viewport: A full-bleed A4 sheet. Four highlighted totals under the header. SKU rows in condensed type. Record sale is a ballpoint line at the foot.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: the paper ledger wearing the shop's clothes.

options.label: Till Board
options.thesis: Sales, expenses, and stock are live rows on a flap board. Delayed is loss. Cancelled is stockout.
options.viewport: A steel-framed board. Condensed white caps in fixed cells. Today's totals as the header row. Sales cascade in underneath. Record sale is SET ENTRY.
options.case: Holds product clarity: a live row board already is a ledger. Loses identification: the owner does not read money as a station board.
options.risk: Reads as operations-software cosplay if the flaps are illustration instead of a real character grid.

options.label: Cabinet Score
options.thesis: Profit is the high score. Stock is lives. Expenses hit like damage.
options.viewport: A 240-line playfield. Score, cash, spend, stock pinned to the top edge in 8-by-8 caps.
options.case: Loses both axes. Arcade glow is not how a shopkeeper reads rupees, and a sprite scoreboard hides cost versus selling price.
options.kept: Module-pitch grid. Flash reserved for alerts.
options.risk: Novelty that fights a daily till.

options.label: Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a light table
options.thesis: Each book (profit, cash, spend, stock) is a tinted glass slide on a goldenrod bed.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides. Rank by weight and reversal, never by size.
options.case: Loses both. Goldenrod travel ephemera is foreign to the bazaar, and one type size fights glanceable PKR figures.
options.kept: Body data shares one size. Only glance figures step up.
options.risk: Pretty and slow at the counter.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Profit, cash, spend, and stock swell as four flat-colour lobes.
options.viewport: One lobe dominates. The coast is the only divider.
options.case: Loses both. Garden maps are not Hall Road, and organic lobes fight tabular inventory.
options.kept: Hard seams instead of card chrome.
options.risk: A picture book where a stock list must live.

options.label: Packing Bay
options.thesis: Every zone is labeled in straight quotes. Low stock wears a zip-tie tag.
options.viewport: Quoted plates: "PROFIT" "CASH" "SPEND" "STOCK". A diagonal stripe under whatever is live.
options.case: Loses both. Fashion grammar is a stockroom costume, not the shop's public face.
options.kept: Literal named zones. A live item keeps a packing tag.
options.risk: Looks like a brand lookbook, not books.

options.label: Force Column
options.lineage: tensegrity column of carbon rods and red cord
options.thesis: Sales are tension. Expenses are compression. Net profit is the rigid body they make.
options.viewport: A force diagram of today's till. Pull sales, release expenses, lock stock.
options.case: Loses both. Sculpture language is alien at the counter, and a force metaphor muddies simple P/L.
options.kept: Profit shows both members: sales against expenses.
options.risk: The owner has to decode a sculpture to know if they made money.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A finance dashboard with a sidebar, four KPI cards, and an area chart, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav. Four equal metric cards. A 30-day profit chart. Tables below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other books app by design.
